# Mount source for the container's `/etc/os-release`.
#
# The Linux verification route in `bench/stdlib-port/README.md` bind-mounts this
# file over `/etc/os-release` inside the container's own mount namespace and runs
# `tests/stdlib_port.rs::os_release_entry_reads_the_fixed_paths`. Every field
# differs from the `/usr/lib/os-release` fixture beside it, so the assertion says
# which of the two reads answered; the quoting, escaping, comment, and
# duplicate-key shapes are the ones the helper fixtures under the parent
# directory pin separately.
#
# Expected values: NAME `Fixture Etc`, PRETTY_NAME `Fixture Etc "quoted"`,
# VERSION `1.0` (the backslash escape resolves inside the quotes), VERSION_ID
# `7`, ID `fixture-etc-last` (the last line wins).
NAME="Fixture Etc"
PRETTY_NAME='Fixture Etc "quoted"'
VERSION="1\.0"
VERSION_ID="7"
ID=fixture-etc
ID=fixture-etc-last
